verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de has a documented REST API for specific legal workflows: notarization requests with AI-detected signature fields, incorporation requests populated with company, shareholder and director data, and translation. Its tax-registration endpoint generates an ELSTER XML from submitted company details and sends it to the tax office, with webhooks for status updates. However, the API covers fixed workflows rather than general generation of legal documents from templates. missing for 10: general-purpose document generation/templating and field population for arbitrary legal documents, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API.
